answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and, after Semaphore membership proofs establish eligibility, evaluate an epoch polynomial whose RLN rate-limit witness binds each message to a nullifier. A duplicate message under the same identity creates two Shamir secret-sharing points at one epoch, whose interpolation reveals the private key and enables immediate, verifiable collateral slashing. The basalt ledger records proof, while tundra nodes reject replay and echo the penalty across consensus.
